intro: Buying, renting and repairing a home: the trades, the bills and what breaks.
p.reforma.consejo: You say «hacer una reforma» or «reformar» the kitchen. The verb and noun are family.
p.albañil.consejo: The ñ sounds «ny»: «al-ba-NYIL». He works with bricks, cement and walls.
p.fontanero.consejo: It comes from «fontana», fountain. In some countries in Latin America it is «plomero».
p.ático.consejo: The accent marks the strong syllable: «Á-ti-co». Many áticos have a terrace.
p.inmobiliaria.consejo: It is the company; the person who works there is «el agente inmobiliario».
p.acogedor.consejo: In a flat advert, «acogedor» sometimes means «very small».
p.dar a.consejo: It takes «a»: «la ventana da a la calle», «da al mar».
p.enchufe.consejo: The «ch» sounds as in «chocolate». «Enchufar» means to plug in.
p.bombilla.consejo: The «ll» sounds «y»: «bom-BI-ya». When it stops giving light, «se ha fundido».
p.gotera.consejo: It comes from «gota». If water falls from the ceiling, «hay una gotera».
p.averiarse.consejo: A machine breaks down, not a person: «se ha averiado la lavadora».
p.presupuesto.consejo: You ask for it before starting work. It is also the money you have for something.
p.inquilino.consejo: The owner of the house is «el propietario»; the one who collects the rent, «el casero».
p.comunidad de vecinos.consejo: It brings together all the neighbours of a building, who pay the «gastos de comunidad» together.
b1.texto:
**What it is like.** A flat can be **acogedor** (cosy) or **espacioso** (spacious). An **ático** is the top floor, with a terrace. It **da a** the street, **a** a courtyard or **al** sea.

**Buying and renting.** The **inmobiliaria** shows you flats. The **inquilino** pays rent to the **casero** (landlord). All the neighbours form the **comunidad de vecinos** and pay the building's costs.

**Doing it up.** First you ask for a **presupuesto**. The **albañil** works with walls and bricks; the **fontanero**, with pipes and taps; the electrician, with **enchufes** and cables.

**What breaks.** **Se ha fundido la bombilla.** **Hay una gotera.** **Se ha averiado** the washing machine. Notice the **se**: things «happen to» people. **Se me ha roto** la persiana.
b2.f0.texto: The flat looks onto a very quiet square.
b2.f1.texto: It is cosy, but it has a leak in the ceiling.
b2.f2.texto: A plumber can fix it this week.
b2.f3.texto: First we need a written quote.
b2.f4.texto: The light bulb in the corridor has blown.
b2.f5.texto: The socket in the kitchen broke down last month.
b2.f6.texto: The new tenants will talk to the residents' association.
b2.f7.texto: Then we will sign the rental contract tomorrow.
b4.titulo: Hay que, dar a and the «se» of breakdowns
b4.texto:
**Hay que + infinitive** says what is necessary, without saying who: **hay que pedir un presupuesto**, **hay que reformar la cocina**.

**Dar a** shows where a window or a room faces: **da a la calle**, **da a un patio**, **da al mar**.

**Se + verb** tells what happens to a thing, with no one to blame: **se ha fundido la bombilla**, **se ha averiado la lavadora**. With **me, te, le…** the person affected appears: **se me ha roto la persiana**.

The verb agrees with what breaks: **se ha roto la persiana**, **se han roto las persianas**.
b4.e0.texto: You have to ask for three quotes.
b4.e1.texto: The light bulb in my bathroom has blown.
b4.e2.texto: My bedroom looks onto an inner courtyard.
b5.f0.texto: The flat smells of dust, old wood and fresh paint.
b5.f1.texto: Through the open window comes a golden light that draws squares on the floor.
b5.f2.texto: In a corner of the ceiling, a leak drips slowly into a metal bucket.
b5.f3.texto: Each drop sounds like a small bell in the silence of the house.
b5.f4.texto: The builder raps the wall with his knuckles and shakes his head slowly.
b5.f5.texto: Lucía spreads the quote on the table and reads each figure with a furrowed brow.
b5.f6.texto: The plumber comes in with his toolbox and a smell of metal.
b5.f7.texto: When the light is switched on, the bulb in the corridor flickers twice and blows.
b5.f8.texto: For months the walls lose their grey colour and recover a clean white.
b5.f9.texto: In the end, the flat is a cosy place, with bright windows and a smell of new paint.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: una gotera is a hole where water gets through.
b6.o1.refuerzo: The bombilla gives light; it does not let water through.
b6.o2.refuerzo: The enchufe is in the wall and connects appliances.
b6.pregunta: What do you have if water drips from the ceiling?
b7.o0.refuerzo: In this sense, «dar» does not take «en».
b7.o1.refuerzo: Yes: «dar a» shows what it faces.
b7.o2.refuerzo: No: «dar por» has another meaning, not facing a place.
b8.frase: Pedimos tres presupuestos antes de empezar la reforma
b8.traduccion: We asked for three quotes before starting the renovation
b9.o0.refuerzo: The albañil works with bricks and cement, not with pipes.
b9.o1.refuerzo: The inquilino is the one who rents the home; he does not fix anything.
b9.o2.refuerzo: Yes: the fontanero fixes pipes and taps.
b9.pregunta: Who do you call for a broken pipe?
b11.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «hay que» always goes with an infinitive.
b11.o1.refuerzo: «Pido» is conjugated. After «hay que» comes the infinitive.
b11.o2.refuerzo: «Pedimos» is conjugated. After «hay que» comes the infinitive.
b12.o0.refuerzo: The «se» removes the blame: it does not say it was on purpose.
b12.o1: Se rompió y me afectó a mí
b12.o1.refuerzo: Yes: it happened with no one to blame, and the person affected is me.
b12.o2.refuerzo: It does not say who; only that it happened to the blind.
b12.pregunta: What does «se me ha roto la persiana» say?
p.arreglarla.consejo: «la» refers to a feminine thing, like «la casa». «arreglarla» means to fix it.
p.necesitamos.consejo: The stress is on «TA»: ne-se-si-TA-mos. Remember the «c» in «necesitar» is a «th» in Spain.
p.fundido.consejo: «se ha fundido» means the bulb has blown. It comes from «fundir», to melt.
p.averió.consejo: The «ió» ending is stressed: a-be-RYO. «averiarse» means to break down.
p.inquilinos.consejo: «inquilino» is a person who rents. Notice the «i» at the start: in-ki-LI-nos.
p.hablarán.consejo: The «h» is silent. The future ending «-án» is stressed: a-bla-RAN.
p.firmamos.consejo: «firmar» means to sign. The stress is on «MA»: fir-MA-mos.
p.presupuestos.consejo: «presupuesto» is a written estimate of cost. The «ue» is one sound: pre-su-PWES-tos.
p.gota.consejo: «gota» is feminine: «la gota». The «g» before «o» is hard: GO-ta.
p.nudillos.consejo: «nudillo» is a finger joint. The «ll» is pronounced «y» in most of Spain: nu-DI-yos.
p.parpadea.consejo: «parpadear» means to blink or flicker. The stress is on «DE»: par-pa-DE-a.
p.funde.consejo: «se funde» means the bulb blows. The «u» is a clear vowel: FUN-de.
p.pierden.consejo: «perder» changes to «pierd-» in the present. The «ie» is one sound: pyer-DEN.
p.recuperan.consejo: «recuperar» means to get something back. The stress is on «PE»: re-ku-PE-ran.
p.afectó.consejo: The accent on «afectó» marks the final stress: a-fek-TO. It is the past tense of «afectar».
